Es gibt viele I2C-Geräte, die mit CircuitPython sehr einfach anzusteuern sind. Im Bibliothekspaket sind Bibliotheken für viele I2C-Geräte verfügbar."}]}],"id":"e179e6d3-67f6-455f-b5b6-df61f6ce5a53"}],"id":"73dd593e-de08-4a6f-a5ff-e9974f434ec0"},"id":"234335-course-page","title":"Was ist ein Bus"},{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"ToDo"}]}],"id":"286cefae-6aeb-4358-b20e-39b36203f3f4"},{"plugin":"image","state":{"src":"https://assets.serlo.org/61d209abcb4f3_0c9028830fcdc5571dfb84f05ffaf511688270b9.png","caption":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{}]}],"id":"866ebada-c01e-4671-a8cc-eb52419cf453"}},"id":"db8b4e00-fe40-4263-9e36-5df0f005e902"},{"plugin":"highlight","state":{"code":"import time
import board
import busio
import adafruit_bmp280
import adafruit_sht31d
import adafruit_ssd1306

# Create the I2C interface.
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)
# Create the BMP280 Sensor class.
bmp280 = adafruit_bmp280.Adafruit_BMP280_I2C(i2c)
# change this to match the location's pressure (hPa) at sea level
bmp280.sea_level_pressure = 1013.25
# Create the SHT31-D Sensor class.
sht31d = adafruit_sht31d.SHT31D(i2c)
# Create the SSD1306 OLED class.
display = adafruit_ssd1306.SSD1306_I2C(128, 64, i2c, addr=0x3c)

while True:
    print("Temperatur: {:.1f} C".format(bmp280.temperature))
    print("Luftdruck:  {:.1f} hPa".format(bmp280.pressure))
    print("Seehöhe:    {:.2f} m".format(bmp280.altitude))
    print("Luftfeuchtigkeit: {:.1f} %".format(sht31d.relative_humidity))

    display.fill(0)
    display.text("Temperatur: {:.1f} C".format(bmp280.temperature)        , 0, 10, 1)
    display.text("Luftdruck: {:.1f} hPa".format(bmp280.pressure)          , 0, 25, 1)
    display.text("Seehoehe:  {:.2f} m".format(bmp280.altitude)            , 0, 40, 1)
    display.text("Feuchtigkeit: {:.1f} %".format(sht31d.relative_humidity), 0, 55, 1)
    display.show()

    time.sleep(2)","language":"python","showLineNumbers":true},"id":"196ef715-006e-43dd-a0de-c6ceb247a3d7"}],"id":"a0383d43-5063-41bb-a150-6babf5178742"},"id":"234336-course-page","title":"Display"},{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"ToDo"}]}],"id":"1ba01e69-94be-4984-93b7-5db8e8255909"}],"id":"993fd501-8ac0-47a2-b6fe-50fc9e8b1f19"},"id":"234337-course-page","title":"Strings in Python"}]},"id":"e48de849-882e-4b49-bd78-88976710552f"}}
